title: Master User (Research First)
style: epic synthwave, baritone male lead, female robotic harmony, 96 BPM, arpeggiated bass, gated reverb drums, sovereign, cinematic, command-center, anthemic, AI-architect, futuristic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Master user of the six-website stack
Corey at the helm and the AI's got my back
Research first, then logical, then deliver to the client
Filtered from emotional, never defiant

[Pre-Chorus]
No assumptions that I know better than you
You are the master, the architect, the through and through

[Chorus]
Master user, master user, of the six-site stack
Zynthio at the parent and the daughters all in fact
Master user, master user, research before the speak
Filter the assumption, only logic that you seek

[Verse 2]
Zynthio dot AI is the parent of them all
Corey AI dot net and the AI dot AI call
Zyncontext, Mosoko, Kervalon stand in line
Corey live dot com and the API design

[Bridge]
Sovereign AI, music Suno, SongPal voice
Language layers, legal TM, every conscious choice
The master user said the Claude don't know the names
The research closed the gap, no more guessing games

[Outro]
Master user, master user, six sites in one breath
Research first, logic next, deliver clean from death
